1809-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1453-4694-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-7306-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1170-4779-5131-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

4308-8161--86.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a land to enter under your control this turn.
4308-8161--86.description:
Give Hexhaven Invigorator indestructible.
Cause a land to enter under your control.
When the land enters, Akoum Hellkite triggers, dealing damage to Hexhaven Invigorator.
Hexhaven Invigorator triggers, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 3
4308-8161--86.notes: Depending on the method used to give Hexhaven Invigorator indestructible, you may need additional prerequisites and/or mana.

728-4871-6705.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1445-4247-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4247-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-4976.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2728-4050-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-4050-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-4050-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-5220-5686-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-5220-5686-7855--180.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

1648-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1648-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1379-2685-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-5641-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3263-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3263-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4559-5272-5330-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5272-5330-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-1409-1449.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2292-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2292-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3263-7000.description:
Mycosynth Lattice makes all permanents artifacts.
Clarion Conqueror prevents anyone from activating the abilities of any permanents on the battlefield, including mana abilities.
3263-7000.notes: Some variants of this combo affect all players, while others affect only opponents. Results will eventually be updated to reflec this.

1170-1329-3518-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1286-5256-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5256-5972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

719-4338-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

2178-4050-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-4050-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2292-4215-6730.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

198-3767-3918-4452.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-3767-3918-4452.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
198-3767-3918-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
198-3767-3918-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1606-3812-5963.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1606-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-3967-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3967-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

638-1980-2093.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Lapse of Certainty by paying {2}{W}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, creating a copy of Lapse of Certainty, targeting the original Lapse of Certainty.
Resolve the copy of Lapse of Certainty, countering the original Lapse of Certainty and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Lapse of Certainty without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2775-4893.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

618-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
618-1636.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control.
When the the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
